# V0 claim disposition

| V0 result or claim | Stage 1 disposition | Requirement before future use |
|---|---|---|
| Work/free day p-value, R² and named site ratios | Provisional; hourly intent is valid but V0 implementation is not accepted | H06-specific sample/statistics; corrected hierarchy and dependence; multiplicity; 95% CIs; diagnostics |
| Exercise p-value, R² and four displayed intensity ratios | Provisional V0 history and not one-to-one comparable with the approved binary activity contrast | Reconstruct the four-level V0 result faithfully, then report the new active-versus-sedentary estimand with its own exact sample, interval, diagnostics, and multiplicity |
| 0.92 sleep ratio interpreted as 8% lower “daily exposure” | Provisional and outcome-mislabelled | Exact previous-night frame, interval, temporal diagnostics, and wording that identifies supported hourly melEDI |
| Site p-value | Invalid H06 provenance | Replace; never reuse the H04 object |
| “Unique contributions” of 0.01–0.05 | Unsupported interpretation | Do not reproduce as an additive variance decomposition |
| Weekend model approximately 33 AIC points worse | Provisional V0 exploration | Recompute only under an approved same-frame day-type comparison |
| Time-of-day work/free patterns | Exploratory only | Repaired geometric outcome, cyclic clock, sequence-aware residuals, and a whole-curve interval procedure compatible with `bam(discrete = TRUE)` |
| Associations remain after activity-context adjustment | Withdrawn | Requires a durable approved activity producer and observational, non-mechanistic wording |
| “Small but robust” | Withdrawn | Requires the complete approved Stage 2 sensitivity and diagnostic record |

No manuscript, supplementary, shared preparation, central ledger, or V0 file
is edited at Stage 1.

# Earlier author decisions and revised H06-G1A

The owner resolved the original 13 Stage 1 decisions on 2026-08-01. Decisions
about the estimand, outcome, predictors, day type, site display, multiplicity,
placement, claims, source pin, and exploratory boundaries remain in force.
The mixed-model architecture clauses are superseded by the 2026-08-10 bounded
pilot and now require the revised H06-G1A approval below.

1. **H06-G1 estimand — Option B approved.** The repaired deliberate hourly
   adaptation is primary. The registered daily-metric analysis remains a
   scientifically distinct, unselected reference rather than a routine
   sensitivity.
2. **Primary day type — approved as recommended.** Work/free is primary;
   weekday/weekend is an estimate/CI sensitivity without a new significance
   screen.
3. **Predictor scope — approved with an exploratory boundary.** The primary
   set is work/free, binary activity, and previous sleep duration. Exercise
   location, active travel, sedentary time, previous sleep onset, and final
   wake are exploratory only and are excluded from primary inference.
   Logger-worn status is a measurement-support sensitivity; free-text exercise
   type is excluded.
4. **Outcome — Option B approved.** The only primary response is supported
   one-hour zero-aware geometric mean melEDI. It is not called daily exposure.
5. **Site structure — approved as recommended.** Fixed site, sum-to-zero site
   contrasts, separate hierarchy-preserving heterogeneity tests, and equal-site
   reader-facing marginalization are primary. Observed-sample marginalization
   remains a comparison; the registered random-site mixed form is retained as
   historical construction evidence rather than a routine sensitivity.
6. **Repeated-day/time structure — revised by H06-G1A.** The original
   participant, participant-day, and gap-bounded AR(1) proposal failed. The
   revised primary uses participant-cluster HC3 covariance and finite-cluster
   reference distributions. True-time sequences remain diagnostic, and the
   exploratory GAM/GAMM alone addresses time of day.
7. **Response and clock rules — revised by H06-G1A.** Quasi-Poisson log-mean
   is proposed as primary; fixed-power quasi-Tweedie `p = 1.8` is the working-
   variance sensitivity; `p = 1.9` is rejected. The no-confirmatory-clock,
   sleep-onset unwrap, and 23:00/07:00/8 h center rules remain unchanged.
8. **Multiplicity — approved as recommended.** The active H06-F1–F3 and gap
   families are fixed above. Site-specific effects and paired/common placement
   comparisons receive estimates and 95% CIs without an additional p-value
   screen.
9. **Placement/sample strategy — approved.** All-available near-eye is
   primary; separately refitted paired/common near-eye and chest are
   complementary; all-available chest is contextual.
10. **Sensitivity set — revised by H06-G1A.** The bounded menu above applies;
    HC1/HC2, `p = 1.8`, weekday/weekend, data, standardization, influence, and
    placement comparisons do not create new significance families. The daily
    reference, additional predictor explorations, and GAM/GAMM remain outside
    primary inference.
11. **Intervals, diagnostics, failure rules, and resampling — revised by
    H06-G1A.** All consequential estimates receive 95% participant-cluster
    robust CIs. Unmodified covariance adequacy, cluster-score/leverage,
    targeted participant deletion, leave-site refits, residual lag, and mean
    calibration are mandatory. Any heavy resampling first stops after 50 or
    100 replicates with output and a full-runtime estimate.
12. **Claim gate — approved.** Every V0 number and narrative claim remains
    provisional until the Stage 2 comparison, exact sample, interval,
    multiplicity, and diagnostics are accepted. Deliberate intent is not an
    implementation-validity finding.
13. **Source/upstream disposition — resolved.** The first clause means that
    H06 uses the coordinator-approved immutable `melidosData` 1.0.6 pin rather
    than checking or fetching a newer remote release. Stage 2 will make only a
    read-only assertion of seven TUM S001 rows and zero S101 rows. For
    `KNUST_S005`, the source numeral 3,600 is author-interpreted as seconds,
    yielding 1 h in the H06 exploratory derivation only; the shared source is
    not edited. The stale Preparation 06 narrative remains a coordinator-owned
    documentation request and does not reopen the H06 data gate.

## Author decision requested: H06-G1A

Approval of H06-G1A means approving this complete revised architecture:

1. quasi-Poisson log-link additive mean model for H06-F1 and average effects;
2. separate full site-interaction model for H06-F2 and site-specific
   descriptive estimates;
3. participant-cluster HC3 covariance with `cadjust = TRUE`, `fix = FALSE`,
   and finite `G - 1` *t*/*F* inference;
4. fixed-power quasi-Tweedie `p = 1.8` plus HC1/HC2 as working-variance and
   covariance sensitivities, with no likelihood claims;
5. no participant, participant-day, latent-AR, working-AR, random-site, or
   confirmatory local-clock term in primary inference; and
6. mandatory residual, mean-calibration, participant-influence, site-deletion,
   data, placement, multiplicity, and V0-comparison checks before any claim.

**Current gate:** H06-G1A is awaiting explicit author approval. The earlier
Stage 2 artifacts remain diagnostic construction history and contain no
accepted H06 result. No production refit under this revised architecture,
Stage 3 notebook, Stage 4 preparation companion, manuscript edit, or central
ledger change is authorized by this report. After author approval, the
coordinator must record the revised gate before the H06 worker implements the
production marginal analysis and returns to the Stage 2 author-review gate.

project `renv/activate.R` startup hook did not return. No document code had

hook while pointing `R_LIBS_USER` directly at the existing project library;
no package was installed, updated, or resolved. The exact successful command
was:

```text
env R_PROFILE_USER=/dev/null R_ENVIRON_USER=/dev/null R_LIBS=renv/library/macos/R-4.6/aarch64-apple-darwin23 quarto render audit/hypotheses/H06/01_audit_and_plan.qmd --to html
```
